extracts.lead_summary: The shelf did not hold. XLF lost $54.46 on Monday, sold on 53M and 56M shares Tuesday and Wednesday, pierced its 200-day on Thursday ($52.81 low) and closed the week $0.17 above it. The sector got the thing it was supposed to want — a cool PCE, a +29K payrolls print, the October hike priced out, the curve steeper by about 20bp — and it could not bounce, because a jobs number that kills a hike is also a jobs number that raises the credit question ten days before JPMorgan reports. XLF $53.49 (-2.5% W/W), RSI 27.5, all seventeen tracked names below their 50-day. BAC -5.2%, RSI 22.
